title: Microgrid Controller Development Firmware Engineer - Raleigh/Morrisville, NC
reason: Stack +45; Title fit +6; US +10; Senior salary -45
description_preview:
Delta Electronics is a global innovator at the forefront of technologies powering the future. Since 1971, we’ve been leading the way in high-efficiency power and thermal management solutions. Today, we’re driving transformation across industries with smart, sustainable systems that enable everything from AI, industrial automation, and data centers to EV charging, renewable energy, and intelligent buildings.
At Delta, we’re leading the energy transition with innovative solutions in solar inverters, energy storage systems, and EV charging infrastructure. Our technologies are helping utilities, businesses, and communities decarbonize and build resilient, intelligent energy ecosystems. Join us in creating a cleaner, smarter energy future.
Role Summary
Own the design and in-house development of the real-time control software that runs on the Microgrid Controller (MGC). This role sits at the intersection of power-electronics control theory and deterministic embedded software, building the droop / grid-forming / grid-following, dispatch, mode-transition, and protection logic that coordinates PCS, BESS, PV, and genset assets. You will bring hands-on knowledge of industry-grade controllers and translate control laws into safe, bounded, real-time code verified on HIL.
Key Responsibilities
Develop the MGC real-time control application on a deterministic RTOS/RT-Linux target — droop/VSG, PLL, GFM/GFL reference generation, P/Q dispatch, and bumpless mode transitions within ≤ 1 ms loops
Implement secondary control (P-f and Q-V droop, virtual inertia, SOC-aware allocation, ramp-rate limiting, black-start sequencing, resynchronization) at the 1–100 ms layer
Build protection coordination logic (50/51, 27/59, 81/81R, anti-islanding, interlock state machine, GOOSE fast trip/block) with hardware trip paths executing in ≤ 20 µs
Design and tune power-electronics control loops interfacing to PCS/BESS unit controllers; validate stability, ride-through (LVRT/HVRT), and grid-fault behavior
Configure and program industry controllers
Implement deterministic comms and middleware — IEC 61850 GOOSE/MMS/SV, Modbus TCP, DNP3, PTP (IEEE 1588), lock-free IPC (DDS / shared-memory SPSC queues), with no dynamic allocation on the RT path
Verify all functions on HIL (Typhoon HIL, OPAL-RT, RTDS, dSPACE) for grid-tied, islanded, black-start, failover, and fault-injection scenarios.
Support certification and release evidence — UL 1741 SB, IEEE 1547, IEC 61850 conformance, IEC 62443 / NERC CIP — with clear design and test documentation
Minimum Qualifications
B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Controls, or Computer Engineering (or equivalent experience)
Strong grasp of power-electronics control — inverter current/voltage loops, PLL, droop, grid-forming/grid-following, and inverter-based-resource dynamics
Hands-on real-time embedded software in C/C++ on RTOS (FreeRTOS/SafeRTOS/ThreadX) or PREEMPT_RT Linux, with bounded WCET, ISR, and deterministic scheduling discipline
Practical experience with industry controllers / IEDs
Working knowledge of power-system protocols: IEC 61850 (GOOSE/MMS), Modbus, DNP3, and PTP time synchronization
Experience with model-based design and HIL (MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, Typhoon HIL / OPAL-RT / RTDS) and test automation in Python
Ability to read SLDs, I/O lists, protection settings, control narratives, and register maps; clear technical writing for specs, test plans, and release evidence
Pay Range
USD $140,000.00 - USD $180,000.00 /Yr.
Preferred Qualifications
Microgrid / BESS plant controller, PPC, or grid-forming inverter control development
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Git mono-repo workflows, CI/CD, and formal change control / release gates

About the Role
This is a software engineering role first, wrapped around a product that lives and breathes wireless connectivity. You'll own and extend a mature, multi-product codebase — a Java service bus, LAMP-stack web portals and API facades, a billing/proration engine, and a reporting layer — while also being the technical point of contact for the carriers we integrate with and the customers who run on the platform. The right person writes the code, ships it across our products, diagnoses what breaks, and can then explain the outcome clearly to a non-technical customer. There is significant personal ownership across the stack.
What You'll Do
Service Bus & Integrations (Java)
Build and maintain the Java service bus that drives carrier provisioning and cross-system integrations.
Develop new carrier/customer integrations and enhancements.
Web Portals & API Facade (LAMP)
Develop and support the customer self-care web portal and API facade using PHP, Apache, and MySQL.
Maintain export and data-handling paths that support the platform.
Billing & Provisioning Logic
Work in the billing engine where correctness is critical.
Handle proration calculations, money handling, subscription management, and line-state transitions.
Read existing logic carefully, reproduce reported issues, and fix subtle bugs involving in-place mutation, edge-case proration, and off-by-one cycle calculations.
Reporting (SQL + JasperReports)
Write and optimize complex SQL against a large proprietary schema covering device, usage, provisioning, account, and service-data tables.
Build and optimize Jasper/iReport reports.
Improve memory usage and performance through virtualizers, query refactoring, and streaming exports.
Operate the Codebase
Work with Perforce version control across a trunk and per-product substreams model covering approximately seven products.
Support Docker-built and deployed services.
Work with CI/CD pipelines feeding multiple servers.
Use Unix/Linux for builds, scripting, troubleshooting, and operational support.
Carrier Operations
Manage the SIM lifecycle across carrier platforms such as Verizon/ThingSpace, AT&T, and others, including activations, deactivations, suspensions, moves, and subscription changes.
Understand how integration status and billing state interact.
Diagnose carrier-side problems, such as API outages producing unconfirmed error states.
Reconcile platform records against carrier data dumps and rolling provisioning history.
Trace a line's complete history through the system.

Customer Conversations
Own support tickets end to end.
Gather requirements for onboarding and enhancements.
Translate ambiguous technical states into clear, accurate answers for operations-level customers.
Communicate when requested data or numbers would not be accurate and propose appropriate alternatives.
Handle sensitive coordination involving data exports, migrations, and offboarding with sound judgment regarding scope and liability.
What We're Looking For
3–10+ years of software engineering experience.
Strong experience working across multiple languages and within an existing production codebase.
Strong Java, PHP/LAMP, and SQL skills.
Experience with Apache, MySQL, Unix/Linux, Docker, and version control; Perforce is a plus.
Ability to read, understand, and safely modify production billing and financial logic where precision is critical.
Reporting experience with JasperReports, iReport, or similar technologies.
Strong understanding of performance and memory optimization.
General cellular/IoT and SIM-provisioning familiarity, or the ability to ramp up quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical users.
Self-starting and comfortable working in a small-team, remote environment where you may wear multiple hats.

An Overview Of This Role
As a Fullstack Engineer on the Duo Client SDK team at GitLab, you'll build the shared foundation for every GitLab Duo client. Today, the logic that powers Duo in editors lives inside the GitLab Language Server. We're extracting it into a true software development kit (SDK): a set of well-versioned TypeScript packages that editor extensions, our web-based Duo Chat on GitLab.com, and eventually external applications can use.
You'll work in TypeScript across frontend and backend systems. You'll design the SDK's Node.js core and public application programming interface (API), and work in the clients that use it. The work rewards care about interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility as much as features because other engineers will depend on what you build.
You'll have senior and staff engineers alongside you to help with design. You'll own the implementation of scoped packages and ship improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating with the team on larger architectural changes.
Some Examples Of Our Projects
The Duo Client SDK, extracting versioned, publishable packages from the GitLab Language Server
The GitLab Language Server, rebuilt on top of the SDK as our polyglot surface
Duo Chat on the web, as one of the SDK's first consumers
What You'll Do
Develop secure, well-tested, and performant TypeScript features that solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, writing tests with every merge request and contributing to code reviews and design discussions.
Extract and publish TypeScript packages from the GitLab Language Server, migrating consumers incrementally so no parallel implementation is left to drift.
Design durable public APIs with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, changelogs, and deprecation paths for external consumers.
Build isomorphic core packages that isolate platform-specific behavior in adapters at the edges.
Build and improve SDK client surfaces, including Vue 3 components in Duo Chat on the web, in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.
Strengthen credential handling across hosts, including bearer tokens, session cookies, and CSRF protection.
Optimize bundle size, startup cost, and dependency weight for browser consumers, and support a Tier 2 on-call rotation for urgent engineering issues.
What You'll Bring
Strong proficiency with TypeScript across frontend and backend systems, including experience building and maintaining Node.js services.
Experience with modern build and packaging tools, including monorepos, multi-module builds, ECMAScript modules (ESM), and dependency management.
Experience with Vue 3 and the Composition API, or comparable component-based frontend experience and a willingness to learn Vue.
Experience designing APIs that other people use, with the ability to explain what you'd do differently.
Understanding of the differences between running code in Node.js and in the browser, and how to write code that works in both.
A security-minded development approach, including careful credential handling and performance optimization.
Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in writing about technical problems, propose iterative solutions, and work effectively in an agile environment.
Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and the judgment to ask for help when needed while thriving in a fully remote organization aligned with GitLab's values.
About The Team
The Duo Client SDK team sits in GitLab's AI Clients stage and works closely with teams building GitLab Duo experiences. We collaborate across client surfaces to make thoughtful technical decisions as the platform evolves. We work fully remotely and asynchronously across regions, in the open, following GitLab's values of transparency and open communication.

description_preview:
Job Description
The Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) and Embedded Software Development Tools organization within Virtualization & Embedded Software Development Tools (VEST). In this role, you will play a critical part in designing, building, and operating cloud-based CI/CD platforms and pipelines that support GM’s embedded software production and large-scale virtualized test environments.
You will blend deep CI/CD tooling expertise with strong cloud infrastructure skills to enable automated software builds, scalable Bazel-based build and test systems, and headless execution of test cases against co-simulation packages for embedded vehicle software. These capabilities are hosted on modern cloud platforms, providing integrated virtual workspaces, seamless integration with test environments, accelerated build and test workflows, and continuous visibility into software quality for teams across the enterprise.
What You’ll Do
Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded software production, enabling automated builds, integration, and testing.
Architect, implement, and operate cloud-based platforms that host build, test, and virtualization capabilities as part of an end-to-end CI/CD framework.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (development, test, platform, IT operations, cybersecurity) to define, document, and implement best practices for build, test, and deployment automation.
Ensure the scalability, reliability, availability, and security of CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms, optimizing them for efficient and predictable software delivery.
Integrate CI/CD pipelines with physical and virtual test environments to enable seamless execution of automated test suites and co-simulation workloads.
Develop new and innovative methods to automate provisioning, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of the virtualization platform and associated cloud services.
Monitor and analyze pipeline and platform performance, reliability, and software quality metrics; identify bottlenecks and implement data-driven improvements.
Work closely with software developers, architects, test engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve issues related to builds, pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.
Act as a subject matter expert for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and virtualization within the broader organization, providing guidance, documentation, and training as needed.
Partner with internal IT operations, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and supplier teams to ensure platforms comply with corporate policies, standards, and requirements.
Prepare and deliver clear updates, technical reviews, and live demonstrations of platform capabilities and roadmap to various levels of leadership and external partners.
Stay current with industry trends and advancements in DevOps, cloud-native technologies, and virtualization, and incorporate relevant innovations into the platform.
Your Skills And Abilities (Required Qualifications)
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in software tools, platform, or infrastructure development, with a strong focus on DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and/or cloud-based applications.
Strong expertise in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions (or comparable technologies).
Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (such as Azure or AWS) and relevant services, including containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.).
Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and at least one of C, C++, or Java.
Solid understanding of embedded software development tools, build processes, and workflows.
Knowledge of test automation frameworks, tools, and practices for software validation in both virtual and hardware-in-the-loop environments.
Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipeline solutions for complex, multi-component systems.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills across build, pipeline, and infrastructure layers.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, with a track record of working effectively in cross-functional, Agile/DevOps environments.
Proven ability to lead or drive challenging technical projects with high levels of ambiguity to successful completion.
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Experience developing and maintaining large-scale cloud-native platforms supporting build, test, or simulation workloads.
Familiarity with GM in-house test automation tools and libraries, or similar automotive/embedded test frameworks.
Familiarity with software build systems and tools used for embedded development.
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet, SPI).
Experience with automotive development tools such as Vector CANape/CANoe, dSPACE SystemDesk/VEOS, AutoVal, or Intrepid Vehicle Spy.
Experience integrating or supporting virtual workspaces and remote development environments.
Awareness of corporate cybersecurity standards and best practices and how they apply to cloud and CI/CD platforms.

Description
Alta Planning + Design seeks an experienced
Senior Web Developer (Web Developer III)
to join the Web and Digital Studio within our TDM Marketing & Creative Services team. This role is ideal for a highly skilled, hands-on developer who can independently deliver complex websites, web applications, interactive and data-driven tools, and other digital products while collaborating closely with designers, marketers, GIS and data staff, planners, and project teams across the firm.
The Senior Web Developer will play a key role in expanding Alta’s digital capabilities by building reliable, accessible, and maintainable solutions across a range of technical environments. The role combines full-stack development, systems integration, technical problem-solving, QA/QC, and project collaboration, with opportunities to contribute to emerging digital services, data-intensive applications, and the continued evolution of Alta’s web and digital practice.
About Alta’s TDM Marketing & Creative Services Group
Alta’s Marketing & Creative Services team brings together strategists, marketers, designers, and digital developers to help clients communicate complex ideas, engage audiences, and inspire action. Our work spans branding, campaigns, communications, graphic design, digital strategy, websites, interactive tools, and technology-enabled experiences.
Within this team, the Web and Digital Studio supports web-based and digital products and services across Alta’s client portfolio. The team partners closely with Marketing & Creative Services staff as well as planners, engineers, GIS specialists, civic data analysts, and project teams across the firm to create digital solutions that support both client needs and Alta’s broader services. As our digital work expands, the team is increasingly working across full-stack development, data visualization, APIs and system integrations, marketing technologies, automation, GIS-enabled tools, and other emerging digital applications.
Day to Day
Production Work (70%)
Build and maintain full-stack websites, web applications, interactive dashboards, calculators, and internal tools, translating wireframes and design systems into responsive, high-performing interfaces
Create interactive experiences that let users explore data by geography, time, scenario, or demographics — presenting complex information through maps, charts, and narrative content
Integrate GIS data and web mapping platforms (ArcGIS Online/Portal, ArcGIS Feature Services, StoryMaps, Mapbox, or similar) into web products
Develop APIs, service integrations, and data-processing workflows using Python and frameworks like FastAPI, Flask, or Django
Connect web products to external databases, CRMs, CDPs, and marketing platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Ortto
Configure and extend platforms like ArcGIS StoryMaps/Experience Builder or Tableau as project needs require
Set up website analytics and measurement (Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager) and apply technical SEO and performance best practices
Implement and test accessibility best practices, including WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA standards
Collaboration & Coordination (15%)
Partner with web, graphic design, marketing, GIS, civic analytics, and planning teams to scope and deliver digital products
Coordinate with project managers, designers, and technical staff on requirements and delivery
Support deployment, hosting, and environment coordination alongside Alta's Web and Digital Studio Lead and IT
Peer Review, Testing & QA/QC (10%)
Review code and products for functionality, responsiveness, browser/device compatibility, accessibility, data accuracy, and security
Provide peer review and informal mentorship to other developers
Technical Leadership & R&D (5%)
Contribute reusable components, automation, and internal tools that improve team efficiency and quality
Explore new technologies and approaches to keep Alta's digital products at the leading edge
Qualifications
Required
This position requires a combination of skills, experience and education including, but not limited to
5–8 years of professional web development experience, including a track record of independently delivering production web applications or data-driven digital products
Expert-level comfort with core development tooling: VS Code (or similar), Git/GitHub, Docker, WSL or macOS, and CI/CD workflows
Advanced experience with the modern front-end ecosystem — JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, CSS/SASS, and frameworks like Vue, Nuxt, Astro, or Vite
Working to advanced Python experience with frameworks such as FastAPI or Django; familiarity with PHP is a plus
Experience with geospatial/GIS web mapping platforms (ArcGIS, Mapbox, or comparable)
Familiarity with data visualization or dashboard tools like Tableau
Experience with design/prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud
Strong written and verbal communication skills — comfortable discussing technical topics with both technical and non-technical audiences
A genuine interest in sustainable transportation, active transportation, city planning, or related fields
Bachelor's or associate's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Preferred
Public-sector, planning, transportation, GIS, or other data-intensive application experience; WCAG accessibility certification.
What We Offer
Flexible Schedule
Alta offers a flexible, hybrid work schedule where most employees work from home three days per week. In-office days support our collaborative culture, one of our core values.

About Neurophos
The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.
Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.
We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

description_preview:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.
About The Role
Veeam VDC Security Engineering builds and operates the security platform for a multi-cloud (Azure and AWS) SaaS serving regulated industries. This role sits in Platform Security and helps drive AI/LLM security as a discipline. You will help shape how VDC uses large language models safely (defensively, at scale) and how we use them offensively to find and fix real security defects faster than traditional programs allow.
What You’ll Do
Design and ship the data-handling controls (code, filters, and infrastructure guardrails) for VDC's internal AI tooling and the AI features in our product. Redact sensitive data from prompts, model context, logs, and outputs before any of it reaches a third-party model provider
Build and productionize an AI-enhanced vulnerability reduction capability that plugs into CI/CD, surfaces real defects with a low false-positive rate, and either recommends or applies remediation without eroding developer trust
Publish and evolve a self-serve secure-LLM-use pattern for other VDC engineering teams, including input filtering, output validation, provider-tier data classification, and threat-model shortcuts for teams adding AI features to their products
Threat-model internal AI tools for prompt injection, indirect prompt attack surfaces, model exfiltration, and agent-tool boundary weaknesses. Partner with the red team on findings, then build the fixes and guardrails with tool owners
Partner with Compliance to shape auditor-facing evidence for AI-assisted controls, including which evidence formats hold up when the collector was an LLM and where human review must gate disclosure
Contribute the AI-security lens to adjacent Security Engineering programs where LLMs touch the surface area: vulnerability management maturity, supply chain risk reduction, code owners routing, and compliance evidence collection
Set VDC's direction on emerging LLM security tools and internal AI-forward workflows: what to adopt, what to skip, and what to build in-house
Technologies You’ll Work With
Azure OpenAI Service and other Azure AI Foundry components
Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, and multi-provider LLM APIs used across VDC internal tools
Microsoft Presidio, custom redaction pipelines, or equivalent PII/secrets detection at the prompt boundary
Cycode (SAST / SCA / Secrets) and Wiz for signal fusion into AI-driven remediation
GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps for CI/CD integration of security-review LLM tooling
Python and Go for the AI security tooling stack; comfort reading PowerShell and TypeScript for integration points
Microsoft Sentinel and Log Analytics for the audit trail on AI-mediated security operations
What You’ll Bring
10+ years across security and engineering, with recent focus on AI/ML systems in production (LLM deployments, model risk, or AI-driven security tooling)
Hands-on experience shipping controls (Code, infra or data gaurdrails) that operate on LLM inputs and outputs (redaction, filtering, output validation, prompt-injection defense)
Build and tune detection systems that catch PII and secrets (API keys, credentials, personal data) across large, messy datasets, knowing when a regex rule is good enough, when you need a trained classifier, and when only an LLM can catch it, and justifying that choice on cost, latency, and accuracy grounds
Track record of taking AI/security work from concept to production, including designing for developer trust and false-positive management
Strong cloud security fundamentals across Azure and AWS: RBAC, secret management, key handling, network egress controls
Turn ad-hoc "is this LLM use case safe?" questions into a reusable mechanism (a scoring rubric in PR templates, a lint rule, an approval gate) that teams run themselves, instead of a doc they read once or a person they ping
Comfort building and hardening security tooling in Python and Go
Familiarity with regulated-industry evidentiary expectations (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HITRUST) and how AI-generated evidence intersects with them
Hands-on experience with agentic AI development environments (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot Enterprise) and their operational security implications
A demonstrable track record of shipping production code (a code portfolio, open-source contributions, or internal build history). This is a hands-on building role, not an advisory one
Bonus Skills
Familiarity with LLM attack techniques (prompt injection, indirect prompt attacks, tool-boundary abuse, model exfiltration) enough to threat-model and build defenses
Background in traditional AppSec or SAST that translates cleanly to LLM-augmented vulnerability finding
Contributions to open-source LLM safety or evaluation projects (Presidio, PromptFoo, Garak, etc.)
Prior work with Azure OpenAI Service enterprise data-handling controls and LLM governance patterns
Experience integrating security tooling into developer workflows without becoming a merge-blocking bottleneck
What You'll Get
Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Progr

It all started in sunny San Diego, California in 2004 when a visionary engineer, Fred Luddy, saw the potential to transform how we work. Fast forward to today — ServiceNow stands as a global market leader, bringing innovative AI-enhanced technology to over 8,100 customers, including 85% of the Fortune 500®. Our intelligent cloud-based platform seamlessly connects people, systems, and processes to empower organizations to find smarter, faster, and better ways to work. But this is just the beginning of our journey. Join us as we pursue our purpose to make the world work better for everyone.
Job Description
What You Will Do
We are looking for a search relevance engineer to work with a team to improve a search based question answering platform. At Moveworks, we build search technology to answer enterprise users’ tech questions instantly, by combining modern information retrieval methodology with the latest advancement in natural language understanding. Our core Search product value is achieved through the capability of accurately retrieving, matching and ranking text snippets extracted from heterogeneous knowledge sources, as direct answers to users’ requests. You will play a critical role in boosting answer quality by meeting the challenges such as lexical gap, semantic text understanding, and data sparsity.
We’re building a team that indexes on moving fast, solving challenging product/engineering problems and providing value to our customers. To be successful, you'll be partnering with product, user experience, customer success and other engineering teams to identify, define and build elegant solutions.
Craft new ranking features and optimizing existing ones to enhance relevance metrics
Develop algorithm framework to support diversified ranking features
Design platform and tooling to enable parallel ranking experiments
Develop metrics to evaluate ranking performance
Qualifications
What You Bring To The Table
First-hand experience in traditional information retrieval techniques, or machine learning based ranking models
Capable of deriving insights from query logs analysis and identifying areas of improvement for search quality
Background in text processing, information retrieval, natural language understanding, or machine learning
Nice to Have
Experience in Golang

description_preview:
As a Manager in AI Security Engineering, you will play a critical role in securing the development and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. You will operate hands-on across high-visibility initiatives, embedding security, trust, and resilience into AI systems while enabling rapid, responsible innovation.
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/29/2026.
Work you'll do
You will bring strong engineering depth and applied AI knowledge, combined with expertise in cybersecurity principles, to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This role requires a collaborative, execution-focused leader who can influence teams, mentor engineers, and ensure AI systems meet enterprise security, risk, and compliance expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Secure, Outcome-Driven Delivery
Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions that are secure by design, balancing business value with risk mitigation. Solve complex problems while ensuring protection of data, models, and systems.
Hands-On AI Security Engineering
Actively contribute to architecture, design, and development of AI/ML and GenAI systems with embedded security controls. Integrate security across the SSDLC, including code reviews, testing, and deployment. In this role you will be responsible for managing AI defensive technologies and the operations of those technologies which will evolve over time.
AI Risk Identification and Mitigation
Identify and address AI-specific vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and misuse. Implement practical safeguards to ensure system integrity and trustworthiness.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy
Serve as a trusted technical voice for secure AI engineering. Ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with business and customer objectives.
Engineering Excellence with Security Focus
Maintain high standards for code quality, scalability, and security. Contribute to secure coding practices, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
Iterative and Responsible Innovation
Support rapid experimentation while applying appropriate security guardrails. Enable teams to innovate safely through controlled, risk-aware development practices.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and risk teams to embed AI security into solutions. Balance usability, performance, and security in decision-making.
Standards and Best Practices
Apply and help evolve standards for AI security, including data protection, access control, model validation, and monitoring within DevSecOps and MLOps pipelines.
Communication and Influence
Clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to alignment and informed decision-making.
Impact
This role directly contributes to reducing enterprise risk and strengthening trust in AI systems. Your work will enable secure adoption of AI capabilities while protecting critical assets and maintaining compliance.
The successful candidate would possess these skills
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:
Cyber Security
Technology Support
Technology & Infrastructure
Applications
Relationship Management
Strategy & Communications
Project Management
Financials

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.
Areas of focus include:
Risk & Compliance
Identity & Access Management
Data Protection
Cyber Design
Incident Response
Security Architecture
Business Partnership

Required:
Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business Administration
Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in software engineering, cybersecurity, and/or including AI/ML, with hands-on delivery experience
Minimum 1 year of people and/or process management experience
Preferred:
Strong understanding of AI/GenAI technologies and associated security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data exposure, adversarial threats)
Experience building and securing applications using Python, JavaScript, or similar, along with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
Familiarity with secure development practices (DevSecOps) and integrating security into CI/CD and MLOps pipelines
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native security principles
Knowledge of data protection, identity/access management, and secure architecture patterns
Ability to work across teams, mentor engineers, and contribute to a strong engineering culture
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant insights

description_preview:
As a Manager in AI Security Engineering, you will play a critical role in securing the development and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. You will operate hands-on across high-visibility initiatives, embedding security, trust, and resilience into AI systems while enabling rapid, responsible innovation.
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/29/2026.
Work you'll do
You will bring strong engineering depth and applied AI knowledge, combined with expertise in cybersecurity principles, to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This role requires a collaborative, execution-focused leader who can influence teams, mentor engineers, and ensure AI systems meet enterprise security, risk, and compliance expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Secure, Outcome-Driven Delivery
Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions that are secure by design, balancing business value with risk mitigation. Solve complex problems while ensuring protection of data, models, and systems.
Hands-On AI Security Engineering
Actively contribute to architecture, design, and development of AI/ML and GenAI systems with embedded security controls. Integrate security across the SSDLC, including code reviews, testing, and deployment. In this role you will be responsible for managing AI defensive technologies and the operations of those technologies which will evolve over time.
AI Risk Identification and Mitigation
Identify and address AI-specific vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and misuse. Implement practical safeguards to ensure system integrity and trustworthiness.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy
Serve as a trusted technical voice for secure AI engineering. Ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with business and customer objectives.
Engineering Excellence with Security Focus
Maintain high standards for code quality, scalability, and security. Contribute to secure coding practices, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
Iterative and Responsible Innovation
Support rapid experimentation while applying appropriate security guardrails. Enable teams to innovate safely through controlled, risk-aware development practices.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and risk teams to embed AI security into solutions. Balance usability, performance, and security in decision-making.
Standards and Best Practices
Apply and help evolve standards for AI security, including data protection, access control, model validation, and monitoring within DevSecOps and MLOps pipelines.
Communication and Influence
Clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to alignment and informed decision-making.
Impact
This role directly contributes to reducing enterprise risk and strengthening trust in AI systems. Your work will enable secure adoption of AI capabilities while protecting critical assets and maintaining compliance.
The successful candidate would possess these skills
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines

description_preview:
As a Manager in AI Security Engineering, you will play a critical role in securing the development and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. You will operate hands-on across high-visibility initiatives, embedding security, trust, and resilience into AI systems while enabling rapid, responsible innovation.
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/29/2026.
Work you'll do
You will bring strong engineering depth and applied AI knowledge, combined with expertise in cybersecurity principles, to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This role requires a collaborative, execution-focused leader who can influence teams, mentor engineers, and ensure AI systems meet enterprise security, risk, and compliance expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Secure, Outcome-Driven Delivery
Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions that are secure by design, balancing business value with risk mitigation. Solve complex problems while ensuring protection of data, models, and systems.
Hands-On AI Security Engineering
Actively contribute to architecture, design, and development of AI/ML and GenAI systems with embedded security controls. Integrate security across the SSDLC, including code reviews, testing, and deployment. In this role you will be responsible for managing AI defensive technologies and the operations of those technologies which will evolve over time.
AI Risk Identification and Mitigation
Identify and address AI-specific vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and misuse. Implement practical safeguards to ensure system integrity and trustworthiness.
Technical Leadership and Advocacy
Serve as a trusted technical voice for secure AI engineering. Ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with business and customer objectives.
Engineering Excellence with Security Focus
Maintain high standards for code quality, scalability, and security. Contribute to secure coding practices, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
Iterative and Responsible Innovation
Support rapid experimentation while applying appropriate security guardrails. Enable teams to innovate safely through controlled, risk-aware development practices.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and risk teams to embed AI security into solutions. Balance usability, performance, and security in decision-making.
Standards and Best Practices
Apply and help evolve standards for AI security, including data protection, access control, model validation, and monitoring within DevSecOps and MLOps pipelines.
Communication and Influence
Clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to alignment and informed decision-making.
Impact
This role directly contributes to reducing enterprise risk and strengthening trust in AI systems. Your work will enable secure adoption of AI capabilities while protecting critical assets and maintaining compliance.

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines

Lead end-to-end AI solution development or transformation programs using cloud AI services, enhancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and decision-making across various industries
Act as a trusted advisor to senior and C-level client stakeholders, shaping AI strategies and roadmaps while positioning KPMG's AI solutions as strategic enablers of business objectives
Oversee the design, architecture, and delivery of multi-agent conversational AI systems and automation solutions, ensuring seamless integration, quality, scalability, and security within enterprise workflows
Drive business development to expand KPMG's AI portfolio by identifying market opportunities, developing proposals, and securing new client engagements, while fostering strategic alliances
Manage and mentor cross-functional teams, promoting a high-performance culture, technical excellence, and career development, ensuring the team stays at the forefront of AI and cloud engineering technology advancements
Work closely with our Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other related platform teams to develop our AI capabilities and offerings within the relevant ecosystems
Set a clear strategic vision for AI strategy and engineering offerings, staying updated on the latest AI advancements and innovations, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring alignment with KPMG's digital strategy
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Minimum eight years of recent experience in AI/ML, data analytics, and cloud technology, including leadership roles in consulting or technology organizations; AI certifications (for example: Professional AI Architect, Machine Learning Engineer) or equivalent are a plus

Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with Microsoft, AWS, and/or Google Cloud's AI ecosystem (including agent build functionality) to design and orchestrate intelligent multi-agent systems such as chatbots and virtual assistants that handle complex, dynamic tasks and conversations

Deep understanding of scaling AI-driven solutions, ethical AI, and MLOps practices for maintaining models; ability to bring industry consulting insights with a balance of technical and business acumen to deliver strategic, value-driven AI solutions; In-depth knowledge of AI orchestration and best practices

description_preview:
The KPMG Advisory practice is at the forefront of transformation, offering excellent opportunities for individuals to advance their careers and expertise with KPMG. Looking ahead, we anticipate continued evolution and success within the practice, fostering both personal and professional development, thereby creating new pathways for growth. In this ever-changing market environment, our professionals must be adaptable and thrive in a collaborative, team-driven culture. At KPMG, our people are our number one priority. With a wealth of learning and career development opportunities, a world-class training facility, and leading market tools, we help our people continue to grow both professionally and personally. If you're looking for a firm with a strong team connection where you can be your whole self, have an impact, advance your skills, deepen your experiences, and have the flexibility and access to constantly find new areas of inspiration and expand your capabilities, then consider a career in Advisory.
KPMG is currently seeking a Director, AI Strategy Architect to join our Advisory Services practice.
Responsibilities:
Lead end-to-end AI solution development or transformation programs using cloud AI services, enhancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and decision-making across various industries
Act as a trusted advisor to senior and C-level client stakeholders, shaping AI strategies and roadmaps while positioning KPMG's AI solutions as strategic enablers of business objectives
Oversee the design, architecture, and delivery of multi-agent conversational AI systems and automation solutions, ensuring seamless integration, quality, scalability, and security within enterprise workflows
Drive business development to expand KPMG's AI portfolio by identifying market opportunities, developing proposals, and securing new client engagements, while fostering strategic alliances
Manage and mentor cross-functional teams, promoting a high-performance culture, technical excellence, and career development, ensuring the team stays at the forefront of AI and cloud engineering technology advancements
Work closely with our Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, and other related platform teams to develop our AI capabilities and offerings within the relevant ecosystems
Set a clear strategic vision for AI strategy and engineering offerings, staying updated on the latest AI advancements and innovations, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring alignment with KPMG's digital strategy
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment
Qualifications:
Minimum eight years of recent experience in AI/ML, data analytics, and cloud technology, including leadership roles in consulting or technology organizations; AI certifications (for example: Professional AI Architect, Machine Learning Engineer) or equivalent are a plus
Advanced degree from an accredited college or university in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field preferred; minimum of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university is required
Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with Microsoft, AWS, and/or Google Cloud's AI ecosystem (including agent build functionality) to design and orchestrate intelligent multi-agent systems such as chatbots and virtual assistants that handle complex, dynamic tasks and conversations
Proficient in architecting and implementing AI-powered workflow solutions using Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud services (For example: Foundry, Bedrock, Vertex AI), with capabilities in defining blueprints and technical requirements for scalable, automated systems with expertise in agentic AI and automation
Skilled in designing multi-agent conversational AI systems integrated with enterprise applications (CRM, ERP), enhancing customer engagement through smart chatbots and virtual agents to improve user experience and operational efficiency; experienced in conversational AI integration
Deep understanding of scaling AI-driven solutions, ethical AI, and MLOps practices for maintaining models; ability to bring industry consulting insights with a balance of technical and business acumen to deliver strategic, value-driven AI solutions; In-depth knowledge of AI orchestration and best practices
Travel as needed
Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Responsibilities:
Lead end-to-end AI solution development or transformation programs using cloud AI services, enhancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and decision-making across various industries
Act as a trusted advisor to senior and C-level client stakeholders, shaping AI strategies and roadmaps while positioning KPMG's AI solutions as strategic enablers of business objectives

The Facilities Mechanical Engineer I will support the design of new infrastructure and buildings under the guidance of a licensed engineer. The successful candidate will assist in the production of design and construction documents, contributing to the delivery of high-quality mechanical engineering solutions.

Support the design of new infrastructure and buildings under the supervision of a licensed engineer.
Assist in the production of design and construction documents, including mechanical drawings, plans, and specifications.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure design alignment with project goals and objectives.
Conduct research and provide support for mechanical design solutions and concepts. For systems including HVAC, Chilled Water, Compressed Air, etc.
Prepare and review mechanical drawings, plans, and specifications for accuracy and compliance with project standards.
Support the coordination of project schedules, budgets, and resources.
Stay informed of industry trends, technologies, and advancements to contribute to project innovation.
Prepare for and pursue a Professional Engineering license after gaining the required experience.
Mentor and provide guidance to junior team members on best practices and design principles.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam.
Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and practices.
Proficiency in mechanical engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit).
Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and other advanced engineering technologies.
Familiarity with sustainable design principles and practices.
Previous internship or work experience in a mechanical engineering firm.

WA applicants is $81,313.00 - $113,837.85
Other Site Ranges May Differ
